name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Marketing & Sales Enablement | Seller-Ready Proof, Customer Voice & B2B Content
summary: B2B marketer and former top-performing SaaS account executive with 15+ years across sales, customer success, enablement, and content. I've been the seller who needed the right proof at the right deal stage, so I know which evidence moves a deal and which just gets published. I've used third-party research as sales-enablement material in a partner channel, built automated review-generation programs for clients, trained partners and tenured AEs to communicate product value, and written thought leadership and conversion copy for B2B audiences. I measure content by what it does for pipeline, using Salesforce, HubSpot, GA4, and SQL.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built automated review-generation sequences that capture customer reviews after service, turning satisfied customers into public social proof for local businesses.
Write and publish thought leadership, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture and CRM for B2B audiences.
Build reusable marketing assets and messaging frameworks, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand and vertical.
Build dashboards tracking funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, using GA4, CRM analytics, and SQL.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced conversion-focused campaign assets (landing pages, multi-touch email sequences, copy), coordinating production across internal creative and media teams.
Built campaign reporting tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, and presented recommendations in QBRs.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Used Whitespark's published industry research as sales-enablement proof to sell Birdeye's listings solution through a channel of 15-20 reseller partners, retaining all but one (~94%).
Trained and equipped partners to communicate product value to their own customers across health, home services, and retail, selling a reputation and review-management platform.
Fed structured, prioritized customer feedback to Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K, and reached finalist stage in a multi-stakeholder pursuit of a major northeastern U.S. bank.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Developed sales training for tenured account executives on a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 25% improvement in conversion rates and 30% traffic growth across the e-commerce segment.
Led a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (20, later 8) while holding 120% of sales targets.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran complex B2B SaaS sales cycles with C-suite buyers at agencies and professional-services firms, ranking top three on a team of 8 to 15 while quota roughly doubled.
Closed deals of $20K+ and averaged ~$17,750/month in implementation and services bookings (~$213K annualized).
